verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs say you can add `.md` to any page's URL to get a Markdown version, and position this as clean Markdown export for AI tools and LLM workflows. Fetched `.md` URLs on mintlify.com (e.g. use-cases/api-reference.md, switch.md) returned content, which corroborates the pattern in practice. However, a probe of the docs root at /docs.md returned 404, so the root/index path appears not to follow the 'every page' pattern. Missing for 10: confirmation that index/root pages also serve .md, independent hands-on verification across docs pages, and documentation of how clean the output is (e.g. how components are rendered).
